Lina (partnerships): Quick sync: partner requested a combined marketplace + SI announcement for Snowflake + Databricks connector on Thu. Need to confirm demo perf and listing assets.
Omar (eng): Which demo slot? We have Thurs morning staging or Fri long-run. Thurs is tight for soak.
Priya (pm): Partner wants Thurs to align with their analyst brief. Legal needs 48h to review PR copy. possible?
Dan (field-eng): Tech checklist: ingest -> snowflake stage -> databricks transform -> vector DB upsert. I'll run a smoke with 5k docs. commands below.
Dan (field-eng): ```bash
# smoke populate
python demo_ingest.py --source samples/faq.ndjson --to snowflake --batch 250 --concurrency 4
# run transform
dbrun --job 902 --params '{"input":"/mnt/samples"}'
# upsert vectors
./upsert_milvus --collection rw_demo --file out/vectors.parquet
```
Omar (eng): perf note: on 4xA10 we get p50 ~180ms for 1k token queries. need p95 and memory spike numbers. I'll run an overnight soak.
Lina (partnerships): Partner via Partner Bot: "We can do a dry run Wed afternoon. We'll share logo + quote by Wed 11:00 PT." :white_check_mark:
Priya (pm): Action list: (1) Dan -> smoke Wed AM, post logs; (2) Omar -> overnight soak Tue, p50/p95 CSV; (3) Lina -> collect assets + draft PR; (4) Legal -> review by Wed EOD.
Dan (field-eng): I'll add badges for marketplace tile: "Snowflake-ready", "Databricks-validated", "Milvus-compatible".
Omar (eng): note: cap ingest concurrency to 6 in demo script to avoid CPU spikes. add `--concurrency 6`.
Lina (partnerships): I'll schedule final sync Wed 9:00 PT. Thanks everyone. :calendar:
